# Research 1: mechanics

## Mechanics

Blood Hunt is a spear attack that consumes Blood Loss.[^m1] A spear in the league digest adds bleed, but the PoB pin doesn't know it.[^m2]

## Supply search

- Blood Loss: Blood Hunt itself (lookup_game_data gem "Blood Hunt"), used by every card; the digest's spear (data/league), used by "Blood Hunt with a bleed unique".
